needs-triage.description: Awaiting a maintainer assessment; not implementation approval.

triage/needs-information.description: Waiting for the specific information or decision requested in the issue.

triage/accepted.description: A trusted maintainer accepted the current scope for implementation.

awaiting-release.description: The accepted fix is merged; delivery to the affected installation is pending.

needs-verification.description: Verified delivery evidence is recorded; the reporter should test the fix.

acmm.description: An ACMM criterion finding from structured compliance intake.

agent/security.description: Filed or owned by the security agent.

agent/strategist.description: Filed or owned by the strategist agent.

ai-fix-requested.description: Explicit implementation request; acceptance and human/safety gates still apply.

area/agents.description: Agents destination, Agent Mode, and assistant integration.

area/configuration.description: YAML configuration, user preferences, and capability visibility.

area/features.description: Features destination and optional system capabilities.

duplicate.description: This issue or pull request already exists

epic.description: High-level tracking issue grouping multiple tracer-bullet features

from-review.description: Issue filed from review findings; informational provenance, not approval.

human-only.description: Human interaction only: no machine analysis or agent implementation.

kind/bug.description: Something is broken or behaves incorrectly.

kind/debt.description: Accumulated technical debt to pay down; descriptive classification only.

kind/task.description: An explicit maintenance or implementation task.

needs-decision.description: Waiting on a maintainer decision; not contributor work until its owner resolves it.

needs-human.description: Human input required: issue implementation is gated; PR automated repair may be escalated.

needs-kind.description: A maintainer must establish exactly one kind; classification is missing or ambiguous.

tracking.description: Standing dashboard or portfolio tracker, not an implementation task.

wontfix.description: This will not be worked on
